WHY BIZZINTEL EXISTS

Less business advice.
More useful instructions.

BizzIntel helps people understand the real steps involved in building a business. It is about learning a process and doing the work—not generating another generic plan.

OUR APPROACH

Built from an operator's perspective.

BizzIntel is a project from Bahamas AI Solutions, founded by Amar Pearson. The lessons reflect practical subjects explored through building and operating ventures: testing demand, planning finances, creating a digital presence, reaching customers, and improving day-to-day operations.

Individual examples are labeled as illustrations; we do not present draft exercises as independently proven results.
